Mazloom Zamanay Tay Shabbir Jaya Koyi Nahin.

Jidi Behan Sharafat Di Malka Hay Rida Koyi Nahi

Ais Fahni Jahan Andar, Haar Cheez Fana Ho Si
Shabbir Nu Ro Laye Ik Pal Da Wasa Koyi Nahi

Hath Chuman Ya Gal Chuman, Akhay Veer Namazi Nu
Zakhman Ton Rahi Khali Veeran Teri Jaa Koyi Nahi

Jeri Veer Di Maqtal Chon, Zalim Nay Utha Chori
Ainj Behan Zamanay Tay Medi Sain Siwa Koyi Nahi

Khaimay Chon Vaindi Rahi, Ummat Day Zulman Nu
Ruk Shimar Gaya Ohdon Jadon Vaikhya Saah Koyi Nahi

Rona Tay Ibadat Ay, Zainab Di Amanat Ay
Pal Do Pal Ro Laye Pal Bhar Da Wasa Koyi Nai

from pathlib import Path
import re

original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{path}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, yaml, source = Path(path).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]

    return [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdecimal()]
assert [line.lower().rstrip('.') for line in verses(original)] == [line.lower() for line in verses(roman)]

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have matching verse counts and stanza breaks.

I updated the language from Urdu to Panjabi (`pa-Arab`) because the grammar is Punjabi throughout, and cleared the missing-source tag. I read the ambiguous Roman `Jaa` as `جا` (“place”). Only the selected lyric was edited.
